hero.subtitle: Eliminate middlemen, secure instant payments with smart contract escrow, and verify harvest authenticity with immutable blockchain provenance.

metamask.headline: Connect Your Wallet in 3 Simple Steps
metamask.subheadline: AgriChain uses MetaMask to securely process payments and verify identities.
metamask.step1_desc: Download the official MetaMask extension for your browser or the app for your mobile device.
metamask.step2_desc: Follow the instructions to create a new wallet. Keep your 12-word seed phrase safe and secret!
metamask.step3_desc: Click 'Connect Wallet' on our platform to securely link your MetaMask wallet and start trading.
